# Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Product design of the Visual TikZ Editor

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the accessibility requirements (FR-080 to FR-092, SC-007, SC-008, User Story 9, research R18, and the Roles, states, and focus section of the surfaces contract) before Phase 16 starts
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does each WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA criterion have a row in research R18 with a requirement or a stated reason for no subject? [Completeness, Research §R18]
- [ ] CHK002 Does each control of every surface table have a role and a state in the Roles, states, and focus section? [Completeness, Contract §Roles, states, and focus]
- [ ] CHK003 Are name, role, and state requirements stated for Quiver's own controls in a `tikzcd` document, or is their exclusion stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-080, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Is each status message of FR-087 listed with its text in the surfaces contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-087]
- [ ] CHK005 Does each function of FR-086 have a chosen tap mechanism with its prior art, with none left open? [Gap, Research §R18]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the fields that FR-088 covers listed in full, and is the text of each refusal specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-088]
- [ ] CHK007 Does FR-062 list the Toolbar Position setting that R18 uses as the tap alternative for FR-010? [Gap, Spec §FR-062]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "the colours beside them" in FR-082 defined for a mark that lies over the figure, where the neighbouring colour is the author's? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-082]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "the order of the surface" in FR-085 stated as one sequence for landscape and for portrait, and for each toolbar edge? [Clarity, Spec §FR-085, Contract §Focus]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "fully cover" in FR-085 defined so that a partly covered focus indicator has one verdict? [Clarity, Spec §FR-085]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the order in which Tab selects objects on the canvas defined for layers, groups, and locked objects? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-084, Research §R18]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the amount by which an arrow key moves the selection specified in figure coordinates? [Gap, Spec §FR-084]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "a fade" in FR-089 bounded so that it is distinct from the motion the requirement forbids? [Clarity, Spec §FR-089]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the path-input exception defined by a rule that decides a new tool, and not only by its three examples? [Clarity, Spec §FR-084, Spec §FR-086]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the keyboard rules of FR-084 agree with FR-012 (Undo and Redo shortcuts) and with the shortcuts of Settings › Keyboard shortcuts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-062]
- [ ] CHK016 Does Tab on the canvas (FR-084) agree with the rule that Tab leaves every surface (FR-085)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-084, Spec §FR-085]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the visible label of FR-081 agree with FR-070 and SC-003 (no instruction sentence) for every field? [Consistency, Spec §FR-081, Spec §FR-070]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the tooltip rule of FR-091 agree with research R11 (a tooltip on pointer hover only) and with FR-085 for a focused control? [Consistency, Spec §FR-091, Research §R11]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the release rule of FR-092 agree with FR-009 and FR-021 (second tap on the active tool or preset) and with the press that closes a popover (T119)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-092]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the radio role of the tools and presets in the contract agree with a second activation that opens a menu (FR-009, FR-022)? [Consistency, Contract §Roles, states, and focus]
- [ ] CHK021 Do constitution Principle IX and Principle II state one measure for the hit region and for the pen-only reach, with no conflict? [Consistency, Constitution §II, Constitution §IX]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Does SC-007 name the axe-core version and rule tags, so that a later version cannot change the verdict without a recorded change? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Research §R18]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the set of "states reached by the browser stories" in SC-007 enumerable from the surfaces contract? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK024 Can the 3:1 focus-indicator contrast of FR-085 be measured on every background the control can have? [Measurability, Spec §FR-085]
- [ ] CHK025 Does each rule that axe-core cannot find (focus order and return, keyboard operation, tap alternatives, status messages, reduced motion) have an acceptance scenario in User Story 9? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 9, Research §R18]
- [ ] CHK026 Can "not by hue alone" in FR-083 be decided objectively for each listed state? [Measurability, Spec §FR-083]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are the focus requirements defined for the case where the control that opened a surface no longer exists when it closes? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-085]
- [ ] CHK028 Are keyboard requirements defined while a construction is in progress (FR-030 to FR-034): placing a point, Cancel, Finish? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-084]
- [ ] CHK029 Are keyboard and tap requirements defined for Edit Points: selecting a point, Smooth, Corner, Split, Delete, Done? [Coverage, Spec §FR-053, Spec §FR-086]
- [ ] CHK030 Are status-message requirements defined for a message that changes again before it is read (Saving, then Saved)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-087]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the requirements stated for both appearances and for the system contrast setting (Increase Contrast), or is that setting excluded? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-082]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the text-size requirements of FR-090 defined for portrait, where a panel is a sheet? [Coverage, Spec §FR-090, Spec §FR-061]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the screen-reader presentation of the figure's objects (a name for each object on the canvas or in Layers) required or excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-080]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Is the choice of Levels A and AA, with two Level AAA measures, recorded as decided by the user? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications 2026-11-20]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the assumption that WCAG applies as written to the desktop web view validated for WebKitGTK and its assistive-technology bridge? [Assumption, Research §R18]
- [ ] CHK036 Does each mechanism that the contract adds (canvas Tab selection, role choices) cite the documented behaviour of a named application, as Principle III requires? [Traceability, Constitution §III]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
